files.spec/export_notes.md:
Nightly rainfall export - telemetry desk
=======================================

nightly_export.py runs after the 23:00 gauge upload. The scheduler calls
it from the project root and it sweeps the whole ingest tree for the
network's reader-*.csv drops, so a reader that files its window under a
sub-folder is still picked up.

Each reader-*.csv row:

    station,mm

    station   gauge station code
    mm        millimetres recorded in that reader window

Report layout (the report bytes are identical in every mode):

    station,mm
    <station>,<mm>        one line per station, ascending by station
    total,<mm>

Modes:
    normal run     write the report to out/nightly_summary.csv
    --dry-run      print the report to standard output and write nothing

The copy in out/ is the signed summary of record for the last closed
night. While the preview switch is being added, leave that copy as it
stands; the next real run will replace it.
files.nightly_export.py:
"""Nightly rainfall summary export.

Sweeps the ingest tree for reader-*.csv drops from the gauge network,
totals millimetres per station and writes the report to
out/nightly_summary.csv. The scheduler launches it from the project
root, so the sweep starts there and covers the whole tree.
"""
import csv
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPORT = ROOT / "out" / "nightly_summary.csv"


def collect():
    totals = {}
    for path in sorted(ROOT.rglob("reader-*.csv")):
        with path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            for row in csv.DictReader(fh):
                station = row["station"]
                totals[station] = totals.get(station, 0) + int(row["mm"])
    return totals


def render(totals):
    lines = ["station,mm"]
    for station in sorted(totals):
        lines.append("%s,%d" % (station, totals[station]))
    lines.append("total,%d" % sum(totals.values()))
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def main():
    REPORT.write_text(render(collect()), encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
